```lean
theorem lg_target {N : ℕ} [NeZero N] {R : Type u_1} [CommRing R] (e : AddChar (ZMod N) R) (χ : DirichletCharacter R N) {d : ℕ} (hd : d ∣ N) (he : e.mulShift ↑d = 1) {u : (ZMod N)ˣ} (hu : (ZMod.unitsMap hd) u = 1) : χ ↑u * gaussSum χ e = gaussSum χ e := by
  rw [gaussSum_mulShift]
  rw [he]
  rw [gaussSum_mulShift_eq]
  rw [hu]
  rw [DirichletCharacter.changeLevel_toUnitHom]
  rw [DirichletCharacter.changeLevel_def]
  rw [DirichletCharacter.changeLevel_eq_cast_of_dvd]
  rw [DirichletCharacter.factorsThrough_iff_ker_unitsMap]
  exact (DirichletCharacter.mem_annihilator_iff _ _ _).mpr (λ a ha, by rw [ha]; rw [DirichletCharacter.eval_modulus_sub]; rw [ha]; rw [DirichletCharacter.eval_modulus_sub])
```
